part.text:
All routes and files have been migrated from the Pages Router to the Next.js App Router with TypeScript types, and the `pages/` directory has been removed:

- **Layout & Document (`_app.js`, `_document.js`)**: Consolidated into `app/layout.tsx` using `Metadata` API and `next/font/google` (`Inter`).
- **Context Provider (`components/AppProvider.tsx`)**: Added `'use client'` directive and TypeScript interfaces.
- **Error & 404 Pages (`_error.js`, `404.js`)**: Replaced with `app/error.tsx` (`'use client'` error boundary) and `app/not-found.tsx` using `useRouter` from `next/navigation`.
- **Pages (`index.js`, `blog/index.js`, `blog/[id].js`)**: Migrated to async Server Components (`app/page.tsx`, `app/blog/page.tsx`, `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`) using `headers()` from `next/headers`, `Metadata` / `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`, `notFound()`, and `revalidate`.
- **API Routes (`api/posts/index.js`, `api/posts/[id].js`)**: Migrated to Route Handlers in `app/api/posts/route.ts` (`GET`, `POST`) and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (`GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) using `NextRequest` and `NextResponse`.
